title: bind exact operator approval to AgentCore PlanSpec and SecurityExecutionEngine approval

files.role: exact approval, AgentCore PlanSpec, and SecurityExecutionEngine denial projection script

criteria: The projection script consumes RC9-020 target enrollment denial and upstream RC9 publication, drift, and fetch denial evidence before evaluating exact approval binding.
The exact approval artifact records exact-approval-denied with approval_granted=false and exact_approval_bound=false.
The AgentCore PlanSpec binding artifact records planspec-binding-denied with executable=false and a deterministic PlanSpec core hash.
The SecurityExecutionEngine decision artifact records security-execution-denied with allowed_effect_set empty, controlled-canary-activation denied, and no side effects.
The task preserves production_ready_claim=false and moves the next task to RC9-022 controlled canary activation.
